# George Wall

> London-based full-stack developer in financial services. I build .NET Roslyn analysers, source generators, developer tooling, and iOS apps that catch bugs early — moving failures from production pain to a red squiggle in your editor.

George Wall (georgewall.uk) is the personal portfolio of a full-stack developer working across .NET/C#, TypeScript/React, and Swift/SwiftUI. The through-line is compile-time safety: tools that make bad code complain while it is still cheap to fix.

## Open-source projects

- [LinqContraband](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LinqContraband): Roslyn analyser that catches EF Core performance problems (N+1 queries, client-side evaluation) at compile time.
- [DependencyInjection.Lifetime.Analyzers](https://www.nuget.org/packages/DependencyInjection.Lifetime.Analyzers/): Catches captive dependencies, leaked scopes, and DI lifetime mismatches at compile time, with zero runtime overhead.
- [CancelCop](https://www.nuget.org/packages/CancelCop.Analyzer/): Analyser for CancellationToken propagation across handlers, EF Core, HTTP, and Minimal APIs, with code fixes that wire the token for you.
- [AutoMapper Analyser](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AutoMapperAnalyzer.Analyzers): Flags missing and misconfigured AutoMapper maps at build time, before they turn into runtime surprises.
- [ConfigContraband](https://www.nuget.org/packages/ConfigContraband): Checks .NET Options and appsettings contracts before configuration mistakes reach startup.
- [HttpClient Resilience Analysers](https://www.nuget.org/packages/HttpClient.Resilience.Analyzers): Catches unsafe retries, lifetime mistakes, response-ownership bugs and dropped cancellation in outbound HTTP code.
- [CPMigrate](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/CPMigrate/): CLI that migrates .NET solutions to NuGet Central Package Management with dependency-health analysis and safe rollback.
- [NotifyGen](https://github.com/georgepwall1991/NotifyGen): C# source generator that eliminates INotifyPropertyChanged boilerplate via a [Notify] attribute.

## Writing

- [When HTTP retries make failures worse](https://www.georgewall.uk/writing/when-http-retries-make-failures-worse): Retry storms, unsafe methods, latency budgets, idempotency and compile-time checks for fragile outbound HTTP policies.
- [Catching broken appsettings before deployment](https://www.georgewall.uk/writing/catching-broken-appsettings-before-deployment): How .NET Options and JSON configuration drift apart, and how to catch the mismatch before startup.
- [Catching N+1 queries at compile time](https://www.georgewall.uk/writing/catching-n-plus-1-at-compile-time): Why N+1 and client-side evaluation survive code review and tests, and how a Roslyn analyser moves the catch to a red squiggle in the editor.
